name: Quality-preserving model plan
description: Reduce an agent's token or model cost without dropping below a verified quality floor.

payload.name: Quality-preserving model plan
payload.description: Compare runtime-available models against representative eval results before applying a less expensive choice.

fields.recommendedModel: Use the top compatible quality suggestion after representative evals
fields.rationale: Select an agent, compare available models on correctness and safety evals, and use automatic quality selection only when representative results remain above the quality floor.
